items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to contributions to family tuition accounts
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7576

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the tax law, in relation to
contributions to family tuition accounts

 PURPOSE :

To increase tax free contributions to family tuition accounts.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Amends tax law section 612(c)(32) to provide that an
account owner who is an individual or head of household can now make a
contribution that shall not exceed $10,000 instead of $5,000 and
married couples who file joint tax returns can contribute $20,000
instead of $10,000 to New York State college choice tuition savings
accounts.

Section 2. Sets for the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Planning for the future is one of the most important things any
household can do in regard to saving for college expenses. By allowing
double the current contribution through New York State college savings
accounts, it allows all families to plan better and contribute more in
advance of the eventual goal to send their child to college.

As always, it is vital that New York State contribute as many tools to
families as possible in regard to saving and planning for higher
education. The expansion of contribution limits to these college
savings accounts would help families across New York State.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately and shall apply to taxable years beginning on and after
January 1, 2017.

summary: Increases the amounts of contributions that may be made tax free to family tuition accounts.
title: Increases tax free contributions to family tuition accounts
